# logcut v0.1.20

## Changes

- Limit captured command output to 10 MiB per log file.
- Continue draining output after the limit while the foreground command is running so large-output commands can finish normally.
- Stop the output-capture helper after a bounded best-effort drain when the foreground command exits.
- Add a truncation marker to the retained log and print a notification when output is truncated.
- Add regression coverage for the size limit, preserved child exit code, finalized logs, and explicitly redirected background processes.

## Compatibility

- Existing commands, profiles, exit-code behavior, and retention settings are unchanged.
- Logs that would previously grow beyond 10 MiB are now truncated.
- Writes by background descendants to inherited stdout or stderr after the foreground command exits are not guaranteed. Redirect stdin, stdout, and stderr explicitly when a background process must continue.
